# v2.1.0 Release Notes Draft

This release adds support for portable/window air conditioners and Hampton Bay landscape transformers, hardens the Homebridge UI login flow, and includes field-tested fixes for fan speed, portable AC fan control, and Hubspace color-temperature formats.

## Highlights

- Portable/window AC support via HomeKit **HeaterCooler** accessories.
- Hampton Bay landscape transformer support with master power, zone switches, and overload fault reporting.
- More reliable Homebridge UI login and 2FA flow with timeouts, server acknowledgements, and safer retry handling.
- New `excludedDevices` config option for hiding unwanted Hubspace devices from HomeKit.
- Fan and portable AC speed behavior fixes to avoid Home app slider jumps and duplicate writes.
- Better Hubspace color-temperature compatibility, including `4000K` values and category-only devices.

## Added

- **Portable/window air conditioners:** Hubspace `portable-air-conditioner` devices now expose power, cooling target temperature, current temperature, and fan speed in HomeKit.
- **Landscape transformers:** Hampton Bay smart landscape transformers now expose master power plus one switch per detected zone.
- **Excluded devices:** Add `excludedDevices` as a comma-separated list of friendly names to skip during discovery. Matching is case-insensitive and unmatched entries are logged as warnings.

## Fixed

- **Login UI hangs:** The plugin settings login flow now times out cleanly instead of spinning forever when a Homebridge UI IPC message is dropped.
- **False connected state:** The UI no longer reports "Connected" after a timed-out or failed login attempt.
- **Login race conditions:** Concurrent login and OTP submissions are serialized so stale retries cannot overwrite the current 2FA session.
- **Slow auth status on reopen:** Plugin settings now check auth status with fresh request/response handling instead of waiting on a one-time push event.
- **Fan power-on flash:** Fans keep reporting their stored speed while off, preventing the Home app from briefly jumping to 100% on power-on.
- **Portable AC speed formats:** Models reporting values like `fan-speed-3-033`, `fan-speed-3-066`, and `fan-speed-3-100` now read and write correctly.
- **Portable AC fan slider:** The fan slider keeps its last speed while off and no longer turns the AC off when dragged to the bottom.
- **Concurrent writes:** HomeKit writes queued together are coalesced into one Hubspace PUT request to avoid API 400 errors.
- **Color temperature:** `4000K`-style values parse correctly, writes preserve the device's expected value shape, and category-only devices snap to the nearest allowed Kelvin value.
- **Poll log noise:** Repeated per-device poll failures are suppressed after the third warning until the device recovers.

## Changed

- `npm run dump` now runs the standalone `scripts/dump-devices.js` directly.
- The dump script supports Windows/non-TTY password prompt fallback and `HUBSPACE_EMAIL` / `HUBSPACE_PASS` environment variables.
- Unsupported-device debug output uses the shared redacted state-value formatter.
- README supported-device, config, troubleshooting, and device-dump instructions were updated.

## Removed

- Removed the old compiled `src/dump-devices.ts` entrypoint from the package.
- Removed unused `@homebridge/plugin-ui-utils`.
